## Pre-Processing 

```{r pre-processing}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(Azimuth)
library(SeuratData)

#Some process in here is random
set.seed(12245)

# Define your data directory, patients, and their outcomes
data_dir <- paste0(getwd(), "/data/")
samples <- list.files(path = data_dir, include.dirs = TRUE)

# Function to import and format each sample as a Seurat object
format_sample <- function(smpl){
  
  # 1. Read the Cell Ranger directory
  data <- Read10X(data.dir = paste0(data_dir, smpl))
  
  # 2. Create the Seurat object
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data, project = "KidneyTransplant")
  
  # 3. Add metadata: Patient ID and Outcome
  obj$patient_id <- smpl
  obj$outcome <- ifelse(str_detect(smpl, "Fail"), "Graft_Failure", "Stable")
  
  obj
  
}

# Create a list of Seurat objects
seurat_list <- map(samples, format_sample)

# 4. Merge into one combined object
pbmc <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], 
              y = seurat_list[2:length(seurat_list)], 
              add.cell.ids = samples)
```

## Quality Control

```{r distributions}
fig.num <- 1

# 1. Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

mt_summary <- pbmc@meta.data %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarize(median_mt = median(percent.mt),
            mad_mt = mad(percent.mt),
            upper_limit = median_mt + (3 * mad_mt))

f_summary <- pbmc@meta.data %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarize(median_f = median(nFeature_RNA),
            mad_f = mad(nFeature_RNA),
            lower_limit = median_f - (3 * mad_f),
            upper_limit = median_f + (3 * mad_f))

# mt_summary
# f_summary

#Identify the max upper limit across patients to use for filtering
mt_cap <- ceiling(max(mt_summary$upper_limit))

# 2. Visualize QC metrics to decide on filtering cutoffs
vp <- VlnPlot(pbmc, 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
        ncol = 3, 
        group.by = "patient_id", 
        alpha = 0.2)

samples_clean <- paste0(str_replace(samples, "_", " ("), ")")

vp[[1]] <- vp[[1]] + 
  labs(title = "Genes per Cell", x = "") +
  scale_x_discrete("", labels = samples_clean)

vp[[2]] <- vp[[2]] + 
  labs(title = "Molecules per Cell", x = "") +
  scale_x_discrete("", labels = samples_clean)

vp[[3]] <- vp[[3]] + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = mt_cap, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "% Mitochondria", x = "") +
  scale_x_discrete("", labels = samples_clean)

vp +
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Figure ", fig.num, 
                                 ": Pre-Filtering Quality Control Metrics"))
```

```{r feature-plot}
fig.num <- fig.num + 1

plot1 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt", 
                        group.by = "patient_id")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA", 
                        group.by = "patient_id")
plot1 + plot2
```

```{r filter}
# 3. Subset data to cells with less than the calculated cap mitochondrial reads,
#    more than 200 genes detected, and fewer than the patient-specific gene cap
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, 
               subset = percent.mt < mt_cap &
                          nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                          ((patient_id == samples[1] & 
                              nFeature_RNA < f_summary$upper_limit[1]) |
                           (patient_id == samples[2] & 
                             nFeature_RNA < f_summary$upper_limit[2]) |
                           (patient_id == samples[3] & 
                             nFeature_RNA < f_summary$upper_limit[3]) |
                           (patient_id == samples[4] & 
                             nFeature_RNA < f_summary$upper_limit[4])))
```

## Normalization 

```{r normalization}
pbmc <- SCTransform(pbmc, 
                    vars.to.regress = "percent.mt",
                    verbose = FALSE)
```

## Data Reduction

```{r pca}
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, assay = "SCT")
```

## Data Integration and Clustering

```{r unintegrated-umap}
fig.num <- fig.num + 1

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca")
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 2)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", 
                reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

# 1. Create the Patient UMAP with your custom labels
p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = "patient_id") + 
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Patient", labels = samples_clean) +
  labs(title = "Patient",
       x = "UMAP1", 
       y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# 2. Create the Cluster UMAP
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", 
              group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) + 
  labs(title = "Cluster", 
       x = "UMAP1", 
       y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

(p1 | p2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Figure ", fig.num, 
                                 ": Pre-Integration UMAP Visualization"))
```

```{r harmonize}
fig.num <- fig.num + 1

pbmc <- IntegrateLayers(object = pbmc, 
                        method = HarmonyIntegration, 
                        orig.reduction = "pca", 
                        new.reduction = "integrated.harmony",
                        verbose = FALSE)

# re-join layers after integration
# pbmc[["SCT"]] <- JoinLayers(pbmc[["SCT"]])

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, reduction = "integrated.harmony", dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.4)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.harmony", 
                reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

# 1. Create the Patient UMAP with your custom labels
p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "patient_id") + 
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Patient", labels = samples_clean) +
  labs(title = "Patient",
       x = "UMAP1", 
       y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# 2. Create the Cluster UMAP
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.harmony", 
              group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) + 
  labs(title = "Cluster", 
       x = "UMAP1", 
       y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

(p1 | p2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Figure ", fig.num, 
                                 ": Post-Integration UMAP Visualization"))
```
